name: grep
description: Powerful content search across files using the host ripgrep binary. Supports full regex (rg syntax), glob filters, file-type filters, three output modes ('content' / 'files_with_matches' (default) / 'count'), and contextual matches. Pattern syntax is ripgrep — not POSIX grep — so escape literal braces as needed and use `(?s)` for dotall multiline.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regex pattern. Uses ripgrep / Rust-regex syntax (close to PCRE; backreferences not supported).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File or directory to search in. Absolute paths used as-is; relative paths resolved against the session cwd. Defaults to the session cwd.

inputs.name: glob
inputs.description: Optional glob filter on file paths (e.g. "*.cc", "*.{ts,tsx}"). Maps to rg --glob; multiple patterns can be space-separated.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Built-in file-type filter (rg --type). Common values: cc, h, js, ts, py, rust, go, java, md.

inputs.name: output_mode
inputs.description: One of 'content' | 'files_with_matches' | 'count'. Default 'files_with_matches'. 'content' returns matching lines (with optional context); 'files_with_matches' returns paths only (cheapest); 'count' returns per-file totals.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Lines of context around each match (rg -C). Only meaningful when output_mode='content'. Overrides before_context/after_context if set.

inputs.name: before_context
inputs.description: Lines of context before each match (rg -B). Only meaningful when output_mode='content'.

inputs.name: after_context
inputs.description: Lines of context after each match (rg -A). Only meaningful when output_mode='content'.

inputs.name: show_line_numbers
inputs.description: Include line numbers in 'content' mode (rg -n). Defaults to true. Ignored in other modes.

inputs.name: head_limit
inputs.description: Cap output: in 'content' mode max N matching lines; in other modes max N files. Default 250; pass 0 for unlimited.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Skip first N entries before applying head_limit (for pagination).

inputs.name: multiline
inputs.description: Enable multiline matching with dotall (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default false. Use when patterns must span line boundaries.
